experiments.notes: v5 extends the existing multibox AutoSummon companion with an opt-in background Anti-AFK toggle. Each client schedules an independent pseudo-random Jump() every 120-360s using local GUID/tick-mixed LCG state; due jumps are deferred while native cast/channel state is active and execute afterward without resetting the random cycle until a jump call is made. Uses in-process FrameScript on the existing timer: no SendInput, cursor movement or foreground focus. SUMMON GUI exposes toggle, seconds to next call, jump-call count and cast/channel defer count. AutoSummon v4 portal background interaction diagnostics remain intact.
